% Pattern: head/number. "Subfact" is a title of a fact, as "Subclaim" is one
% of a claim. A capital letter and a Greek letter in parentheses number the
% head together, as "D(α)", and \eps is the Greek letter epsilon. Seen in the
% gold pilot (set X).
% want head-1 statement/fact D(α)
% want head-2 statement/fact (ε)
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\eps}{\varepsilon}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
We show two facts about the space.

\textbf{Subfact D$(\alpha)$:} Every compact space is bounded.

\textbf{Fact $(\eps)$}: Every finite space is compact.
\end{document}
